basis: Valuer-General (SA) quarterly median house sale price and number of sales by suburb, metropolitan Adelaide; council and city rows are sales-weighted chain composites of suburbs
name: Adelaide
notes: Adelaide: the publisher gives suburb medians only, so the city series and the council-area rows are composites: a fixed-weight chain of the suburbs' median log changes (weights = share of sales over the sample), anchored to the sales-weighted mean of the suburb medians over the latest four quarters. Suburb quarters with fewer than 5 sales are dropped, and suburbs need at least 12 quarters; interior gaps are filled in log space by the panel builder. Houses only. The Office of the Valuer-General's own quarterly median house price for Metropolitan Adelaide and for the non-metropolitan major towns (Millicent, Mount Gambier, Murray Bridge, Port Augusta, Port Lincoln, Port Pirie, Victor Harbor, Whyalla, one figure), 2011Q1 on, are shown for comparison and the metropolitan median is the city series.

volume.basis: house sales in metropolitan Adelaide, Valuer-General (SA), sum of suburb counts
